title: Rainbows

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Rainbow
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: A rainbow is an arc of colours in the sky. You can see a rainbow when the sun shines through falling rain. Rainbows often come after storms.
A rainbow has seven colours. They are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet. Red is on the outside. Violet is on the inside.

Sunlight looks white, but it is really many colours together. Drops of water split the light into colours. You can also see a rainbow near a waterfall. In many cultures a rainbow is a symbol of peace.

questions.q: When can you see a rainbow?
options: When it is dark and very cold outside
When there is a strong wind and no sun
When the sun shines through falling rain
